integrity: Proof and finite verification have been examined consistently for the stated domain; this is not an independently audited priority or proof certification.
scientific_limitations: All new formulas are proved only for the positive edge-attribute incidence context of complete graphs K_{2n} with n>=3. The finite checker covers n=3 exhaustively and n=4 structurally and by reproducible samples. The known matching-complex homotopy types and general poset fiber theorem are credited, not newly established. Equivalent literature may exist under different terminology.
title: One-factor incidence lattices: optimal direct implications and Hermite Möbius invariants
